experienceProblem: The game promised that the player would hear and locate a monster before pursuit, but the browser adapter emitted no sound during the hidden sign phase and automated play deliberately created no AudioContext.
technicalCause: Spatial audio only handled approaching and later phase transitions with one generic sawtooth cue timed from wall-clock performance, while the semantic harness exposed no way to unlock or inspect WebAudio.
change: The browser adapter now maps footstep, metal, breath, water, electrical, and voice channels to six distinct multi-pulse procedural motifs. Hidden warning cues repeat from authoritative expedition time, pan from Corridor acoustics, tighten before pursuit, pass through a bounded compressor, and retain only 64 diagnostic records. The semantic harness can unlock and inspect audio, and the existing live proof requires a running context plus repeated same-channel directional cues before approaching begins.
boundary: Dread still owns encounter selection, sign duration, bearing, pursuit, blackout, response, collection, and capture. Corridor still owns acoustic pan. The audio adapter reads snapshots and schedules presentation only; no audio state enters snapshots, saves, network payloads, or gameplay outcomes.

apprehensionCurve.safeBaseline: The first encounter still waits for 90 meters of traversal; later encounters still wait for 55 meters.
apprehensionCurve.ambiguousCue: The first live encounter entered its hidden sign phase at 29.90 seconds with a paired-footfall motif and no visible monster.
apprehensionCurve.repetition: Four same-channel motifs occurred at 29.90, 31.40, 32.65, and 33.90 seconds.
apprehensionCurve.escalation: The planned interval tightened from 1425ms to 1025ms while the warning threat rose from 0.084 to 0.148.
apprehensionCurve.confrontation: Visible pursuit began afterward at 34.65 seconds and retained the learned footstep motif at a 902ms interval.
apprehensionCurve.release: Resolved encounters use a separate release chime; blackout and capture retain distinct low-frequency transitions.

proof.fullLive: passed gameplay, caught/restart, persistence, 18-building traversal, all landmark captures, host/client replication, disconnect, and recovery with zero console or network errors
proof.runtime: passed 36 shipping cores, 38 development cores, 49 explicit kits, six distinct sensory motifs, 124 manifestations, 1920 meters, and 10.49 authored minutes

humanExperience.visibleStates: Spawn, movement, directional response, blackout, last chance, resolution, caught/restart, and late-route landmark frames remained readable after the audio change.
humanExperience.functionalAudio: A real running AudioContext and timestamped WebAudio schedule prove that the hidden directional warning is emitted before pursuit and follows the active monster contract.
humanExperience.remainingCaveat: This environment cannot perform a subjective headphone judgment of timbre, loudness, fatigue, or fear response. Those mix qualities remain unverified until a human listening pass.
humanExperience.nextBlocker: Run one headphone playtest and tune only the mix if needed; after that, the next broader quality slice is encounter behavioral variation or long-route pacing.
